title: fix(rest): /meta routes forward ?preview=draft (list + get, cache-bypassed) — Live Canvas draft apps
body:
Found in live staging verification of the Live Canvas: a freshly built draft app (`procurement_system`) opened the split-screen canvas, but the iframe showed **"No Apps Configured"**.

## Root cause
The canvas iframe (`/apps/:name?preview=draft`) reads metadata through REST `/meta/:type` and `/meta/:type/:name`, which dropped the `?preview=draft` flag:
- **list** never overlays pending drafts → a draft-only app is invisible to the app shell (verified live: the single-get with `?preview=draft` returns 200, the list omits it);
- **get** could serve a cached 304 keyed on the *published* checksum even with the flag forwarded.

## Fix
- `GET /meta/:type`: thread `previewDrafts: true` to `protocol.getMetaItems` when `?preview=draft`.
- `GET /meta/:type/:name`: same for `getMetaItem`, and bypass the cached path under preview.

## Tests
3 new route tests in `rest.test.ts` (forwarding, no-flag omission, cache bypass); package suite 103/103; build clean.

Note: an equivalent uncommitted draft of this fix existed on a local working copy (branch `fix/rest-meta-preview-draft-passthrough`, mixed with unrelated approvals WIP) — this PR re-lands just the preview hunks cleanly from main. @os-zhuang 你本地 framework checkout 上那份未提交的同款改动合并本 PR 后可以丢弃(approvals 部分不受影响)。
